output.summary: KEP-2502 adds automatic copy of cluster certificates to secondary control-plane nodes so that kubeadm init and kubeadm join --control-plane can build HA clusters without manual certificate copying. The KEP is implemented and at stable stage.
output.rationale: Creating HA clusters with kubeadm required manually copying cluster certificates from the bootstrap control-plane node to secondary control-plane nodes. The KEP removes that manual step so users can use the same kubeadm init and kubeadm join commands. Its stated goals are usability and secure certificate copying between control-plane nodes.

alternatives.option: A simpler version of the proposal without TTL
alternatives.why_not: Discarded in favor of a more secure approach, per the source.

alternatives.option: Client/server architecture with a service component on a bootstrap control-plane
alternatives.why_not: Discarded due to the higher complexity.

alternatives.option: Kubernetes job that reads certs from a bootstrap control-plane
alternatives.why_not: Discarded due to the limited authorization of the identity used by the kubeadm join workflow.

evidence.quote: This KEP introduces automatic certificates copy, eliminating the manual operation described above and completing the kubeadm solution for creating HA clusters.
Automatic certificates copy makes easier to create HA clusters with the kubeadm tool using exactly the same `kubeadm init` and `kubeadm join` commands the users are familiar with.
a simpler version of this proposal was considered (without TTL), but discarded in favor of a more secure approach

Creation of kubernetes job with the responsibility of reading certs from a bootstrap control-plane; this was discarded due to to the limited authorization of the identity used by the kubeadm join workflow
